title: Cross-Device Ledger Sync
outcome_summary: The multi-store ledger architecture was fully delivered across 15 work packages: 4 new TypeScript storage modules (StoreRegistry, StoreRouter, MultiStoreManager, StoreContext), 10 CLI store subcommands, updated MCP tools and GUI handlers, a Strategy page Conflicts tab, and comprehensive manifest documentation. The system is fully backward-compatible — no stores.json means legacy single-store mode with zero behavioral change. Two code-review FAILs (detectProjectByCwd guard bug, storeRepoMove validate-before-mutate bug) were caught and fixed within the session; the final suite stands at 3,838 MCP server tests and 152 workspace script tests, all passing. The primary gap for the next cycle is project-resolver.ts still routing single-store for work-package and pipeline tools.
project_summary: This project introduces a multi-store ledger architecture that allows the MCP server to manage multiple independent ledger root directories simultaneously, enabling cross-device workflows and personal/company data separation. Each store is fully self-contained with its own projects, knowledge base, and repository registry, with store-order priority for conflict resolution and no coupling to any sync mechanism.
